title: Signals & Interactive Terminal Milestone
summary: v1.4 brings FrostVista its first real signal subsystem: the missing half of the process model.
scope: This milestone does not aim to implement full POSIX signal semantics, real-time signal queues, sigaltstack, ptrace, core dumps, per-thread signal masks, or job-control process groups.

items.title: Process signal state
items.description: Process signal state and fork inheritance.

items.title: Signal primitives
items.description: Signal registration and signal mask basics.

items.title: kill syscall
items.description: Set pending signals and wake sleeping targets.

items.title: Signal delivery checkpoint
items.description: Check pending signals before returning to user mode.

items.title: sigframe and handler entry
items.description: Build a RISC-V sigframe and enter the handler.

items.title: sigreturn
items.description: Restore the saved trapframe and signal mask.

items.title: ABI alignment
items.description: Use the RISC-V and musl handler conventions.

items.title: User-side wiring
items.description: Provide user signal wrappers and the restore stub.

items.title: Ctrl+C in fvsh
items.description: Raise SIGINT from the interactive shell.

items.title: Faults become signals
items.description: Turn unhandled page faults into process signals.

items.title: Ctrl+C shell behavior
items.description: Verify the shell survives an interrupted command.

items.title: Fault-to-signal
items.description: Verify SIGSEGV kills only the faulting process.

validation.command: Existing full suite still passes with signal delivery enabled.
